T040.author: U_PARTNER
T040.text: @greenware_hq Your carbon tracking dashboard just saved our portfolio company 2 weeks of manual reporting. Incredible tool — sharing with our whole network.

T041.author: U_SMALL_BACKER
T041.text: @greenware_hq Love the new scope-3 emissions module. Keep it up!

T042.author: U_DISGRUNTLED
T042.text: @greenware_hq Your data import keeps corrupting our CSV files. We've been locked out of reporting for a week. Totally unacceptable for a paid product.

T043.author: U_CLIMATEEXPERT
T043.text: Corporate sustainability reporting is moving from voluntary to mandatory globally. Companies without real-time emissions data infrastructure will face severe compliance risk by 2027.

T044.author: U_BIGCO
T044.text: ESG software market is getting crowded. @greenrival_co and @greenware_hq both doing interesting things. Curious who comes out ahead.
